name: vectrojs
description: Multi-core analytics engine for JavaScript: columnar tables, SQL and fused SIMD WebAssembly kernels for Node, browsers and edge runtimes, with no native code. Serves tables to Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Grafana, pandas and Polars.
author: Hamza Masood

scripts.test: node test/test-ops.mjs && node test/test-fusion.mjs && node test/test-tables.mjs && node test/test-csv.mjs && node test/test-async.mjs && node test/test-split.mjs && node test/test-balance.mjs && node test/test-stream.mjs && node test/test-ndjson.mjs && node test/test-window.mjs && node test/test-websocket.mjs && node test/test-frames.mjs && node test/test-emitter.mjs && node test/test-arrow.mjs && node test/test-groupby.mjs && node test/test-partition.mjs && node test/test-join.mjs && node test/test-distinct.mjs && node test/test-distinct-wide.mjs && node test/test-types.mjs && node test/test-plan.mjs && node test/test-sql.mjs && node test/test-missing.mjs && node test/test-edges.mjs && node test/test-fast-paths.mjs && node test/test-pack.mjs && node test/test-dataset.mjs && node test/test-topk-dataset.mjs && node test/test-lookup-join.mjs && node test/test-sort.mjs && node test/test-zones.mjs && node test/test-textfns.mjs && node test/test-vectors.mjs && node test/test-mcp.mjs && node test/test-serve.mjs && node test/test-pg.mjs && node test/test-odata.mjs && node test/test-flight.mjs && node test/test-connectors.mjs && node test/test-check-cases.mjs
scripts.test:single: VECTRO_MODE=single sh -c 'node test/test-ops.mjs && node test/test-fusion.mjs && node test/test-tables.mjs && node test/test-csv.mjs'
scripts.test:interp: VECTRO_MODE=interp sh -c 'node test/test-ops.mjs && node test/test-fusion.mjs && node test/test-tables.mjs && node test/test-csv.mjs'
scripts.test:edge: npm run build && VECTRO_MODE=edge sh -c 'node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings test/test-ops.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings test/test-fusion.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings test/test-tables.mjs && node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings test/test-csv.mjs'
scripts.test:browser-sim: VECTRO_MODE=browser-sim sh -c 'node test/test-ops.mjs && node test/test-fusion.mjs && node test/test-tables.mjs && node test/test-csv.mjs && node test/test-async.mjs'
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:single && npm run test:interp && npm run test:edge && npm run test:browser-sim && npm run test:compressed && npm run test:poison
